ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms a worker limit, per-mutant timeout and the shared-worktree flag are declared; it does not run workers.
offer: Bound mutation workers and timeouts while isolating each modified source tree. Shared mutable worktrees allow one mutant to contaminate another verdict.

minimal.reason: Bound the worker count, at least 2 declared. Unbounded workers exhaust the machine, so set a limit.

mid.reason: Set a per-mutant timeout of at least 1000 ms. A mutant can loop forever, so bound each run.

maximal.reason: Set sharing mutable worktrees to false. A shared tree lets one mutant contaminate another's verdict, so isolate each.
